name: Tempester n°20: SysEx 5C (beat n of a project) refused when n > 15
explanation: [routine] ([routine]) case 0x5C stored the beat number byte ([address]) without any check, and [routine] then called [routine](n) ([routine]), which writes [address] + (n * 0xA5 + k) * 4 (k = 4..7), the beat header and events of beat n ([routine], [routine], [routine]) and the 32 sounds of beat n in SRAM ([routine] at n * 0xA00 + pad * 0x50). Valid beats are 0-15 (RAM tables end at [address]): n = 16 overwrites the undo beat in SRAM (sounds 0xA000, events 0x3AA00) and RAM past the tables; n = 17-127 (and up to 255 over USB, where SysEx bytes are not masked) writes far past them. Fix: case 5C reads the number through a helper (0x9d07ba00-0x9d07ba2f); n > 15 jumps to the existing error end of case 70 in the same function and frame ([address]: [address] = 4, [routine](0), then [routine](6, command 0, 0, 9)), which drops the message and ends the screen opened by the start event; the remaining bytes up to F7 then meet an idle SysEx state, as after any refused SysEx. 0-15: unchanged.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07ba00 ; case 5C: was "jal [address]" ([routine]); the delay slot (nop) is kept
addiu sp,sp,-0x18 ; ra = [address], sp = frame of [routine] (ra at 0x14, s0 at 0x10)
addiu sp,sp,0x18 ; delay slot: own frame popped on both paths
jr ra ; n = 0..15: back to case 5C (stores n, substate 6), unchanged
j [address] ; n > 15: error end of case 70 in the same function, same frame (ra and s0 restored by its epilogue)
li s0,0x9 ; delay slot: error code passed to [routine]
